svg.aria-label: One BiGraFV fracture cell: a fracture of aperture b between host-rock walls, 90 percent gypsum and 10 percent open pore (k/k0 = 1). Dilute water dissolves the vein completely, porosity 1, k/k0 = 1/phi0 = 10. Carbonate brine replaces gypsum by calcite, which takes 49.4 percent of the gypsum volume, porosity about 0.55, k/k0 about 5.5. Each fracture is one well-mixed cell.
svg.text: gypsum only: the vein dissolves away
one BiGraFV cell = one whole fracture
well mixed: one φ, one concentration, one k
walls fixed: cell volume = area × b
no front inside a fracture: it opens all at once
